project.title: Vampire: The Masquerade Character Creator
project.summary: A planned browser-based Vampire: The Masquerade V5 creator for standard clan neonates with a live rules ledger, local drafts, and printable sheets.

items.title: Build the first clan and Predator Type path
items.notes: Support one clan and one eligible Predator Type with Discipline allocation, powers, mandatory grants, dependent choices, and validation.

items.title: Evaluate Advantages, Flaws, and starting XP
items.notes: Track starting budgets and ordered purchases. Verify Generation, Humanity, Blood Potency, and the XP balance for the first fixture.

items.title: Complete the first character guide and print sheet
items.notes: Connect concept, relationships, mechanical choices, and review. Verify the full build and its printout against the same fixture.

items.title: Expand the core option catalog
items.notes: Add the remaining named core clans and eligible core Predator Types, source-tagged options, searchable pickers, and manual entries for Storyteller review.

items.title: Save named browser drafts
items.notes: Persist the last step and draft inputs. Report save failures and keep the current draft exportable.

items.title: Support JSON backup and restore
items.notes: Validate the versioned ruleset and draft inputs. Preview before restoring a copy and check partial and complete draft round-trips.

items.title: Share mechanical build links
items.notes: Generate a read-only preview from allowed mechanics and catalog IDs. Verify that names and narrative text stay out of the payload.

items.title: Export the Storyteller brief
items.notes: Preview and download the mechanical build and open rulings in Markdown, with player-selected narrative sections.

items.title: Verify the first release
items.notes: Run rules, persistence, type, and build checks. Rehearse creation through print at desktop and mobile widths and verify public release notices.
